policy: This is a sequence of deliverables, not a promise of background work or a calendar estimate. Verified output means the stated deliverable has evidence, not that a theory is true or a chapter is approved. Changes to this shared baseline require a repository edit. Workbook and personal-board edits do not automatically update it.

phases.title: Preserve and map the corpus
phases.exitCriterion: An immutable source trail and a durable, testable plan.

phases.title: Assemble and verify passages
phases.exitCriterion: Exact passages, usable citations and distinguishable historical reconstructions.

phases.title: Develop complete arguments
phases.exitCriterion: Supporting cases, corrections, counterexamples and intellectual debts are retained.

phases.title: Connect the book
phases.exitCriterion: Cross-chapter dependencies and a narrative order that does not flatten independent arguments.

phases.title: Assemble chapter drafts
phases.exitCriterion: A reproducible manuscript built from approved wording rather than a printed wiki.

phases.title: Review meaning and presentation
phases.exitCriterion: Authorial fidelity, bibliography, dates, ethical claims and accessibility checked separately.

phases.title: Prepare a stable edition
phases.exitCriterion: Frozen content, working links, rights and reproducible publication artifacts.
